sources_used.exhibit: Ex-99.1 (Q4/FY 2025 earnings PR with business separation update)

catalyst_rows.asset: Anaptys biopharma operations (spin-off into First Tracks Biotherapeutics, Nasdaq: TRAX)
catalyst_rows.raw_text: Spin-off of biopharma operations into a public company to be called 'First Tracks Biotherapeutics' on track for Q2 2026, potentially as early as late-April.

catalyst_rows.indication: untreated stage II/III dMMR/MSI-H locally advanced rectal cancer
catalyst_rows.raw_text: AZUR-1 pivotal Phase 2 dostarlimab monotherapy in untreated stage II/III dMMR/MSI-H locally advanced rectal cancer: Top-line data expected in 2026; U.S. FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation; received an FDA Commissioner's National Priority Voucher (CNPV) in Nov. 2025 allowing for only a one to two-month BLA review timeline for US FDA approval.

catalyst_rows.indication: untreated stage III MMRp/MSS resectable colon cancer (plus chemotherapy)
catalyst_rows.raw_text: AZUR-4 Phase 2 dostarlimab plus chemotherapy versus standard of care (chemotherapy) in untreated stage III MMRp/MSS resectable colon cancer: Top-line data expected in Q4 2026.
FDA accepted the BLA filing for imsidolimab in generalized pustular psoriasis (GPP) in Feb. 2026 with a target action date of Dec. 12, 2026.
Phase 1b trial in celiac disease ongoing; Top-line Phase 1b data for both cohorts anticipated in Q4 2026.
Phase 1b trial in eosinophilic esophagitis initiated in Q1 2026; Top-line Phase 1b data anticipated in 2027.
Anticipate providing an update on advancement of rosnilimab in RA, which would be funded by strategic or other outside sources of capital, in Q2 2026.

extractor_notes.tier0_overlap_check: Q4/FY 2025 PR with extensive business separation and pipeline update yields concrete forward catalysts: spin-off Q2 2026 (TRAX); GSK Jemperli AZUR-1 topline 2026 (BTD + CNPV voucher), AZUR-4 Q4 2026; Vanda imsidolimab GPP PDUFA Dec 12 2026; ANB033 Ph1b celiac topline Q4 2026, EoE topline 2027; rosnilimab RA partnership update Q2 2026. AZUR-2 (2028) and JADE (2028) omitted as beyond near-term tier-1 window.
